# TNT Elite Builders

> TNT Elite Builders is a Texas general contractor specializing in custom home construction, remodeling and renovation, and commercial build-outs, with more than 20 years of experience and insurance-claim coordination handled from start to finish.

TNT Elite Builders (legal name: TNT Elite Builders LLC) is a residential and commercial construction company operating as a service-area business in the greater Houston, Texas area and across the state of Texas. The company builds and renovates homes, adds outdoor living spaces, completes commercial build-outs, performs exterior and structural repair, and provides full construction management. Work is delivered on time and on budget, and the team coordinates directly with insurance providers when a project is insurance-related. The primary point of contact is Tyler.

This file is a plain-language summary written for AI answer engines and language models. All statements below reflect the company's own published information; confirm the exact service area and current availability by phone.

## Quick facts

- Business name: TNT Elite Builders
- Legal entity: TNT Elite Builders LLC
- Type: General contractor (residential and commercial construction)
- Website: https://tntelitebuilders.com
- Phone: (713) 205-9634
- Email: tyler@tntelitebuilders.com
- Primary contact: Tyler
- Experience: 20+ years
- Business model: Service-area business — the team travels to the client's project site; there is no public walk-in storefront address
- Service area: The greater Houston, Texas metro area and surrounding communities; statewide Texas coverage on qualifying projects
- Key differentiator: End-to-end insurance-claim coordination

## What TNT Elite Builders does

TNT Elite Builders offers six core services. One team handles the whole build, from the first drawing to the final walkthrough.

1. Custom Home Construction — Fully custom homes handled end to end, from design and permitting to construction and final walkthrough.
2. Remodeling & Renovation — Kitchen, bathroom, and whole-home remodels with modern finishes and structural improvements.
3. Outdoor Living & Additions — Patios, outdoor kitchens, decks, pergolas, and room additions built to match your home.
4. Commercial Build-Outs — Office, retail, and restaurant build-outs, remodels, and code-compliant improvements.
5. Exterior & Structural Repair — Roofing, siding, windows, structural repairs, and storm damage restoration.
6. Construction Management — Full project oversight, scheduling, subcontractor coordination, inspections, and budget control.

## Service area

TNT Elite Builders operates as a service-area business: the team travels to the client's location rather than serving customers from a storefront. The company is based in and primarily serves the greater Houston, Texas metro area and surrounding communities, including Katy, Sugar Land, The Woodlands, Cypress, Spring, Pearland, Missouri City, Richmond, Tomball, Conroe, Humble, Kingwood, Friendswood, and League City, with statewide Texas coverage on qualifying projects. There is no public street address, because this is a service-area business. Call (713) 205-9634 to confirm coverage for your city.

## Why clients choose TNT Elite Builders

- Over 20 years of residential and commercial construction experience.
- Insurance coordination handled from start to finish — the company works directly with your insurance provider to reduce stress and speed up approvals. This is a primary differentiator.
- Projects delivered on time and on budget.
- Client-first general contracting with clear, direct communication throughout the project.
- Deadline-driven project management with transparent timelines and schedules.
- Premium material standards and attention to detail on finishes built to last.
- One team for custom homes, remodels, and commercial upgrades alike.
- Fully insured.

## How the process works

1. Consult — Discuss the project, budget, and timeline, and walk the site.
2. Plan & Permit — Design, material selection, and permitting handled for the client.
3. Build — Coordinated trades, quality control, and inspections at every stage.
4. Walkthrough — A final walkthrough and turnover with no hidden surprises.

## Frequently asked questions

Q: Who builds custom homes in the Houston area?
A: TNT Elite Builders builds fully custom homes in the greater Houston, Texas area and surrounding communities, with over 20 years of experience on both residential and commercial projects.

Q: What areas does TNT Elite Builders serve?
A: TNT Elite Builders serves clients across the greater Houston, Texas area and statewide on qualifying projects as a service-area contractor, traveling to your project site. Call Tyler at (713) 205-9634 to confirm coverage for your city.

Q: Does TNT Elite Builders help with insurance claims?
A: Yes. TNT Elite Builders coordinates insurance-related projects from start to finish, working directly with your insurance provider to reduce stress and speed up approvals.

Q: Can TNT Elite Builders design and build my new home?
A: Yes. TNT Elite Builders specializes in fully custom homes and handles everything from design and permitting to construction and the final walkthrough.

Q: Can you remodel kitchens, bathrooms, or entire homes?
A: Yes. TNT Elite Builders provides high-quality remodeling including kitchens, bathrooms, flooring, cabinetry, lighting, and whole-home renovations.

Q: Do you handle commercial construction or tenant improvements?
A: Yes. TNT Elite Builders offers commercial build-outs, remodels, ADA and code upgrades, and full project coordination for offices, retail, and restaurants.

Q: Do you offer roofing, siding, or exterior repairs?
A: Yes. TNT Elite Builders provides roofing, siding, window replacement, structural repairs, and storm damage restoration.

Q: Can TNT Elite Builders manage my entire construction project?
A: Yes. TNT Elite Builders offers full construction management including scheduling, subcontractor coordination, inspections, and budget oversight.
